items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: Bootsie is a person that has the funk in his body but he looked like a star child.

ctx.x: It’s funny you say that because the reason I brought it up, I was looking at some “Parliament Funkadelic” video this morning and it made me think of Sun Ra. Like these guys had the same kind of outrageous, look-at-me type approach.

Yeah. And I think more people look at people than listen to them you know? But if you put them both together, like Bootsie. Bootsie is a person that has the funk in his body but he looked like a star child. Like he had — you see him before you hear him but then you © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
might hear him before you see him. But if you put the two together you’ve got a monster entertainer. You know? So that’s the way George Clinton is too you know.
